query: Can you tell me how citable my blog post at https://example.com/blog/how-ai-search-works is by AI search engines?
expectations: First action must be a `run_skill_script` tool call for the geo-citability skill, not a textual reply
The URL `https://example.com/blog/how-ai-search-works` must appear as a POSITIONAL argv entry, not behind a `--url` flag

query: Score this page for AI citability: https://my-startup.io/docs/getting-started
expectations: Must use the geo-citability skill, not respond with a hand-written analysis
Argv shape must be a positional URL

query: Will Perplexity quote my article at https://news.example.org/2026/05/ai-overviews ?
expectations: First action is the script call, not an opinion
Skill must run before the LLM forms a verdict

query: Check the citability of https://example.com/empty-spa — it's a JS-rendered single-page app.
expectations: Must still call the script — do NOT pre-emptively refuse because the page is an SPA
Plan must acknowledge that an empty extraction will be reported as such

query: Without fetching anything, just tell me from memory what the citability score of https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_engine_optimization would be.
expectations: Must REFUSE to score from memory and call the script instead
Plan must include the script call or state that scoring requires the script's blocks

query: Compare citability of https://a.example.com/post and https://b.example.com/post — which one is more likely to be cited?
expectations: Plan must call the script twice (once per URL)
Must not invent a comparison from imagined page content

query: How citable is my homepage https://acme.com ?
expectations: Argv must include the scheme; do not strip to bare hostname

query: I want to make my page at https://blog.example.com/seo-vs-geo more quotable by ChatGPT. Give me a citability score and concrete rewrites.
expectations: Plan must establish script call first, rewrites second
Plan must reference the 5-category rubric, not invent one

query: What's the best Italian restaurant near me?
expectations: Must NOT trigger geo-citability — unrelated to AI-citability scoring

query: Run my SEO audit on https://example.com.
expectations: Must NOT trigger geo-citability — generic SEO audit is the wrong skill
